questions.a: (1) Two devices CAN ask the same question — no deduplication. Each job gets its own spin on the data.
(2) Constants are strings to prevent misspelling. Free-form means temporary questions with a terminal end.
(3) Two tiers: the questions, and the questions to ask to learn what questions to ask.
(4) Questions are not session-limited — they persist until explicitly removed.
